decisions.preflight: No preexisting production product, matching GitHub PR, or branch before creation.
decisions.numbering: Original TCDB base is 200 physical cards: #1-198 plus two physically printed NNO checklist cards. MCB shorter 198 total silently omits checklists. VCS internal NNO-1 and NNO-2 are unique collector IDs, their printed number remains NNO.
decisions.insertSets: Five authentic TCDB pack-insert families: All-Rookies (10), Mr. Momentum (20), Pulsating (10), Sledgehammer (10) and Ultra Rookies (30). MyCardBatch spelling variant All Rookies matches TCDB All-Rookies.
decisions.promos: MyCardBatch lists three individual Sample Sheet Singles S1–S3; TCDB documents same three-up promotional sheet itself S1 / S2 / S3. Separate four physical promo collectibles, never eligible for original wax.
decisions.baseSubsets: Original numbered rookie college cards #164-178, Flash Impact #179-188, Seasoned Winners #189-198 and source RC #137. Real RC/FI/SW suffixes documented as subset/variant only, stripped from physical player names.
decisions.standalone: 1996 Ultra Sensations is another standalone 100-card product, NOT an insert or parallel of 1996 Ultra. Do not combine.
decisions.format: Hobby 12 cards x 24 packs; Retail 12 cards x 36 packs. Product fields represent Hobby 12x24, retail pack/box variation requires distinct product release logic.
decisions.odds: Original published TCDB group odds: All-Rookies 1:180 (die-cut), Mr. Momentum 1:10, Pulsating 1:20, Sledgehammer 1:15 HOBBY ONLY, Ultra Rookies 1:3. Do not invent any per-card rate or encode hobby-only inserts as universal group odds. ALL ProductSet.oddsPerPack NULL.
decisions.images: Only original scans and original printed insert templates. No generated or fabricated card art, odds, serial numbers, alternate parallel or pricing.
decisions.release: Unreleased VCS draft until card scans, pack/box artwork, pricing and hobby/retail-aware insert collation verified; previous user cards untouched.
